name: Action Plans
description: Shared Core multi-step planning, execution checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop approval across Agent, Flows, and Plugins.

commands.create_plan: Create a structured multi-step action plan for the active task.
commands.update_step: Update the status of a step in the active action plan.
commands.get_plan: Inspect the current progress and steps of an action plan.
commands.complete_plan: Mark the active action plan completed, failed, or cancelled.

function.name: ACTION_PLANS__create_plan
function.description: Create a structured multi-step action plan for complex tasks (coding, multi-file edits, Flows, or audits). In confirm mode, pauses until user approves.

title.description: Short title describing the overall goal.

steps.description: Ordered list of concise actionable steps.

require_approval.description: Optional override to force waiting for user approval before executing.

function.name: ACTION_PLANS__update_step
function.description: Update a step status ('done', 'running', 'failed', 'skipped', 'pending') in the active Action Plan.

step_index.description: 1-based index of the step to update.

notes.description: Brief outcome note or verified artifact path.

plan_id.description: Optional plan_id; defaults to current session plan.

function.name: ACTION_PLANS__get_plan
function.description: Read the current status and step checklist of the active Action Plan.

plan_id.description: Optional plan_id; omit to inspect current session plan.

function.name: ACTION_PLANS__complete_plan
function.description: Finalize an Action Plan once all steps and verifications are finished.

summary.description: Short final summary of what was accomplished and verified.

plan_id.description: Optional plan_id; omit to close current session plan.
